eval: tests/care/eval/turns.jsonl (150 turns, none in the training data)
model: off (rules, with and without the classifier)
classifier: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (Apache-2.0) embeddings + logistic heads trained on Kaggle (docs/evidence/training/classifier.json)
threshold_sweep: needs_help below 0.8 let the classifier add a wrong 'asked for help' (a false alarm) and lose 4 turns net; at 0.8 and above the classifier changes no turn on this eval
decision: not adopted by default: with the confidence gates the classifier equals the rules on the eval (147/150 both) and without them it is worse; it ships behind IRA_CARE_CLASSIFIER (default off) and may only add signals, never remove one. Revisit when there is real (consented) check-in text to train on.
